sanskrit: nikumbho bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā sugrīveṇa nipātitam pradahann iva kopena vānarendram avaikṣata
english: Nikumbha, seeing his brother struck down by Sugrīva, glared at the lord of the monkeys as if burning with rage.

sanskrit: tataḥ sragdāmasaṃnaddhaṃ dattapañcāṅgulaṃ śubham ādade parighaṃ vīro nagendraśikharopamam
english: Then that hero took up an iron club adorned with garlands and straps, its five-fingered grip fitted, fair to behold, equal in height to the summit of a great mountain.

sanskrit: hemapaṭṭaparikṣiptaṃ vajravidrumabhūṣitam yamadaṇḍopamaṃ bhīmaṃ rakṣasāṃ bhayanāśanam
english: It was bound with bands of gold, adorned with vajra and coral, dreadful as the staff of Yama, the destroyer of fear among the rākṣasas.

sanskrit: tam āvidhya mahātejāḥ śakradhvajasamaṃ raṇe vinanāda vivṛttāsyo nikumbho bhīmavikramaḥ
english: Whirling that club equal to Indra's banner in battle, Nikumbha of terrible prowess roared with open mouth, blazing with great energy.

sanskrit: urogatena niṣkeṇa bhujasthair aṅgadair api kuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca mṛṣṭābhyāṃ mālayā ca vicitrayā
english: With a pendant on his chest, armlets on his arms, a pair of gleaming earrings, and a variegated garland—

sanskrit: nikumbho bhūṣaṇair bhāti tena sma parigheṇa ca yathendradhanuṣā meghaḥ savidyutstanayitnumān
english: —Nikumbha shone with his ornaments and that iron club like a cloud adorned with the rainbow of Indra, accompanied by lightning and thunder.

sanskrit: parighāgreṇa pusphoṭa vātagranthir mahātmanaḥ prajajvāla saghoṣaś ca vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ
english: The knot of air burst apart at the tip of the club of that great-souled one; it blazed with sound like fire without smoke.

sanskrit: nagaryā viṭapāvatyā gandharvabhavanottamaiḥ saha caivāmarāvatyā sarvaiś ca bhavanaiḥ saha
english: Together with the city of Viṭapāvatī and the finest mansions of the gandharvas, together with Amarāvatī and all its palaces—

sanskrit: satārāgaṇanakṣatraṃ sacandraṃ samahāgraham nikumbhaparighāghūrṇaṃ bhramatīva nabhastalam
english: —the sky with its host of stars, its constellations, the moon, and the great planets seemed to spin and whirl, swept by the circling club of Nikumbha.

sanskrit: durāsadaś ca saṃjajñe parighābharaṇaprabhaḥ krodhendhano nikumbhāgnir yugāntāgnir ivotthitaḥ
english: Unapproachable, blazing with the lustre of the club and his ornaments, the fire of Nikumbha, fuelled by wrath, arose like the fire at the end of an age.

sanskrit: rākṣasā vānarāś cāpi na śekuḥ spandituṃ bhayāt hanūmaṃs tu vivṛtyoras tasthau pramukhato balī
english: The rākṣasas and monkeys alike could not stir for fear; but mighty Hanūmān, with chest bared, stood facing him.

sanskrit: parighopamabāhus tu parighaṃ bhāskaraprabham balī balavatas tasya pātayām āsa vakṣasi
english: That strong one, whose arms were like an iron club, brought down upon the chest of the powerful Nikumbha the club that shone like the sun.

sanskrit: sthire tasyorasi vyūḍhe parighaḥ śatadhā kṛtaḥ viśīryamāṇaḥ sahasā ulkā śatam ivāmbare
english: Striking that firm, broad chest, the club was shattered into a hundred pieces and broke apart at once like a hundred meteors in the sky.

sanskrit: sa tu tena prahāreṇa cacāla ca mahākapiḥ parigheṇa samādhūto yathā bhūmicale 'calaḥ
english: Shaken by that blow from the club, the great monkey reeled, as a mountain shakes in an earthquake.

sanskrit: sa tathābhihatas tena hanūmān plavagottamaḥ muṣṭiṃ saṃvartayām āsa balenātimahābalaḥ
english: Though struck thus, Hanūmān, best of the leapers, exceedingly powerful by nature, clenched his fist.

sanskrit: tam udyamya mahātejā nikumbhorasi vīryavān abhicikṣepa vegena vegavān vāyuvikramaḥ
english: Raising it high, that great-splendoured, valiant one swift as the wind hurled it with full force against Nikumbha's chest.

sanskrit: tataḥ pusphoṭa carmāsya prasusrāva ca śoṇitam muṣṭinā tena saṃjajñe jvālā vidyud ivotthitā
english: Then his skin burst open and blood poured out; from that fist-blow a flame arose like lightning.

sanskrit: sa tu tena prahāreṇa nikumbho vicacāla ha svasthaś cāpi nijagrāha hanūmantaṃ mahābalam
english: Though staggered by that blow, Nikumbha collected himself and seized the immensely powerful Hanūmān.

sanskrit: vicukruśus tadā saṃkhye bhīmaṃ laṅkānivāsinaḥ nikumbhenoddhṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā hanūmantaṃ mahābalam
english: At that, the inhabitants of Laṅkā raised a terrible cry in the battle on seeing mighty Hanūmān lifted up by Nikumbha.

sanskrit: sa tathā hriyamāṇo 'pi kumbhakarṇātmajena hi ājaghānānilasuto vajravegena muṣṭinā
english: Even as he was being carried off by the son of Kumbhakarṇa, the son of the wind struck him with a fist swift as the thunderbolt.

sanskrit: ātmānaṃ mocayitvātha kṣitāv abhyavapadyata hanūmān unmamathāśu nikumbhaṃ mārutātmajaḥ
english: Freeing himself and leaping to the ground, the son of the wind, Hanūmān, quickly wrestled Nikumbha down.

sanskrit: nikṣipya paramāyatto nikumbhaṃ niṣpipeṣa ca utpatya cāsya vegena papātorasi vīryavān
english: Hurling him with full exertion and crushing him to the ground, that valiant one sprang up swiftly and fell upon his chest.

sanskrit: parigṛhya ca bāhubhyāṃ parivṛtya śirodharām utpāṭayām āsa śiro bhairavaṃ nadato mahat
english: Grasping him with both arms and twisting his neck, he tore away the great head of the roaring Nikumbha with a fearful wrench.

sanskrit: atha vinadati sādite nikumbhe pavanasutena raṇe babhūva yuddham daśarathasutarākṣasendracamvor bhṛśataram āgataroṣayoḥ subhīmam
english: Then, as Nikumbha fell roaring, slain by the son of the wind in battle, the combat between the army of the son of Daśaratha and the army of the lord of the rākṣasas became far more terrible, both sides consumed with fury.

sanskrit: nikumbhaṃ ca hataṃ śrutvā kumbhaṃ ca vinipātitam rāvaṇaḥ paramāmarṣī prajajvālānalo yathā
english: Hearing that Nikumbha had been slain and Kumbha struck down, Rāvaṇa, exceedingly wrathful, blazed up like fire.

sanskrit: nairṛtaḥ krodhaśokābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ tu parimūrchitaḥ kharaputraṃ viśālākṣaṃ makarākṣam acodayat
english: That lord of the rākṣasas, overwhelmed by both anger and grief, urged on Makarākṣa of wide eyes, the son of Khara.

sanskrit: gaccha putra mayājñapto balenābhisamanvitaḥ rāghavaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ caiva jahi tau savanaukasau
english: "Go, my son, dispatched by me, accompanied by your forces. Slay both Rāghava and Lakṣmaṇa together with the forest-dwellers."

sanskrit: rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā śūro mānī kharātmajaḥ bāḍham ity abravīd dhṛṣṭo makarākṣo niśācaraḥ
english: Hearing Rāvaṇa's words, Makarākṣa, the heroic and proud son of Khara, the night-rover, said boldly: "So be it."

sanskrit: so 'bhivādya daśagrīvaṃ kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam nirjagāma gṛhāc chubhrād rāvaṇasyājñayā balī
english: Having saluted the ten-necked one and circumambulated him, the mighty one departed from Rāvaṇa's bright dwelling by his command.

sanskrit: samīpasthaṃ balādhyakṣaṃ kharaputro 'bravīd idam ratham ānīyatāṃ śīghraṃ sainyaṃ cānīyatāṃ tvarāt
english: The son of Khara said this to the marshal of forces standing nearby: "Let a chariot be brought quickly, and let the army be assembled without delay."

sanskrit: tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā balādhyakṣo niśācaraḥ syandanaṃ ca balaṃ caiva samīpaṃ pratyapādayat
english: Hearing those words, the marshal of forces, a night-rover, brought the chariot and the army near.

sanskrit: pradakṣiṇaṃ rathaṃ kṛtvā āruroha niśācaraḥ sūtaṃ saṃcodayām āsa śīghraṃ me ratham āvaha
english: The night-rover circumambulated the chariot and mounted it, then urged the charioteer: "Drive my chariot quickly."

sanskrit: atha tān rākṣasān sarvān makarākṣo 'bravīd idam yūyaṃ sarve prayudhyadhvaṃ purastān mama rākṣasāḥ
english: Then Makarākṣa addressed all those rākṣasas: "All of you rākṣasas—fight in front of me."

sanskrit: ahaṃ rākṣasarājena rāvaṇena mahātmanā ājñaptaḥ samare hantuṃ tāv ubhau rāmalakṣmaṇau
english: "I have been commanded by the great-souled king of the rākṣasas, Rāvaṇa, to slay both Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa in battle."

sanskrit: adya rāmaṃ vadhiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇaṃ ca niśācarāḥ śākhāmṛgaṃ ca sugrīvaṃ vānarāṃś ca śarottamaiḥ
english: "Today I shall slay Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa, O night-rovers, Sugrīva the tree-roaming animal, and the monkeys with my finest arrows."

sanskrit: adya śūlanipātaiś ca vānarāṇāṃ mahācamūm pradahiṣyāmi saṃprāptāṃ śuṣkendhanam ivānalaḥ
english: "Today with my spear-casts I shall burn down the great army of the monkeys that has arrived, like fire consuming dry fuel."

sanskrit: makarākṣasya tac chrutvā vacanaṃ te niśācarāḥ sarve nānāyudhopetā balavantaḥ samāhitāḥ
english: Hearing those words of Makarākṣa, all those night-rovers, powerful and resolute, equipped themselves with various weapons.

sanskrit: te kāmarūpiṇaḥ śūrā daṃṣṭriṇaḥ piṅgalekṣaṇāḥ mātaṃgā iva nardanto dhvastakeśā bhayānakāḥ
english: Those heroes, able to take any form, fanged, tawny-eyed, hair dishevelled, fearsome, roared like elephants.

sanskrit: parivārya mahākāyā mahākāyaṃ kharātmajam abhijagmus tadā hṛṣṭāś cālayanto vasuṃdharām
english: The great-bodied ones surrounded the great-bodied son of Khara and advanced joyfully, shaking the earth.

sanskrit: śaṅkhabherīsahasrāṇām āhatānāṃ samantataḥ kṣveḍitāsphoṭitānāṃ ca tataḥ śabdo mahān abhūt
english: Then arose a great sound on all sides from thousands of conches and kettledrums beaten together, along with battle-cries and the slapping of arms.

sanskrit: prabhraṣṭo 'tha karāt tasya pratodaḥ sārathes tadā papāta sahasā caiva dhvajas tasya ca rakṣasaḥ
english: Then the charioteer's goad slipped from his hand, and the banner of that rākṣasa fell suddenly to the ground.

sanskrit: tasya te rathasaṃyuktā hayā vikramavarjitāḥ caraṇair ākulair gatvā dīnāḥ sāsramukhā yayuḥ
english: The horses yoked to his chariot, stripped of their vigour, moved with stumbling feet, dejected, their mouths wet with foam and tears.

sanskrit: pravāti pavanas tasya sapāṃsuḥ kharadāruṇaḥ niryāṇe tasya raudrasya makarākṣasya durmateḥ
english: As the terrible, evil-minded Makarākṣa set forth, the wind blew against him, harsh and laden with dust.

sanskrit: tāni dṛṣṭvā nimittāni rākṣasā vīryavattamāḥ acintyanirgatāḥ sarve yatra tau rāmalakṣmaṇau
english: Seeing those omens, the mightiest of the rākṣasas marched out without reflection, all of them, to where Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa stood.

sanskrit: ghanagajamahiṣāṅgatulyavarṇāḥ samaramukheṣv asakṛd gadāsibhinnāḥ aham aham iti yuddhakauśalās te rajanicarāḥ paribabhramur nadantaḥ
english: Dark as clouds, elephants, and buffaloes in hue, scarred again and again by maces and swords in the fore of battle, each crying "I, I first!" those night-rovers skilled in war wheeled about, roaring.

sanskrit: nirgataṃ makarākṣaṃ te dṛṣṭvā vānarapuṃgavāḥ āplutya sahasā sarve yoddhukāmā vyavasthitāḥ
english: Seeing Makarākṣa marching forth, all those bull-like monkeys leaped forward at once and stood ready, eager to fight.

sanskrit: tataḥ pravṛttaṃ sumahat tad yuddhaṃ lomaharṣaṇam niśācaraiḥ plavaṃgānāṃ devānāṃ dānavair iva
english: Then commenced that great and hair-raising battle between the night-rovers and the monkeys, like the battle of the gods with the dānavas.

sanskrit: vṛkṣaśūlanipātaiś ca śilāparighapātanaiḥ anyonyaṃ mardayanti sma tadā kapiniśācarāḥ
english: With hurled trees and spears, with thrown rocks and iron clubs, the monkeys and night-rovers crushed one another.

sanskrit: śaktiśūlagadākhaḍgais tomaraiś ca niśācarāḥ paṭṭasair bhindipālaiḥ ca bāṇapātaiḥ samantataḥ
english: The night-rovers struck with śaktis, spears, maces, swords, lances, broad-bladed swords, slings, and volleys of arrows from every side—

sanskrit: pāśamudgaradaṇḍaiś ca nirghātaiś cāparais tathā kadanaṃ kapisiṃhānāṃ cakrus te rajanīcarāḥ
english: —and with nooses, mallets, staffs, and thunderbolt-like weapons as well; those night-rovers wrought havoc among the lion-like monkeys.

sanskrit: bāṇaughair arditāś cāpi kharaputreṇa vānarāḥ saṃbhrāntamanasaḥ sarve dudruvur bhayapīḍitāḥ
english: The monkeys, tormented by the son of Khara's showers of arrows, became confused of mind and all fled, afflicted by fear.

sanskrit: tān dṛṣṭvā rākṣasāḥ sarve dravamāṇān vanaukasaḥ nedus te siṃhavad dhṛṣṭā rākṣasā jitakāśinaḥ
english: Seeing those forest-dwellers fleeing, all the rākṣasas roared like lions, bold and wearing the air of conquerors.

sanskrit: vidravatsu tadā teṣu vānareṣu samantataḥ rāmas tān vārayām āsa śaravarṣeṇa rākṣasān
english: As the monkeys fled on all sides, Rāma checked the rākṣasas with a rain of arrows.

sanskrit: vāritān rākṣasān dṛṣṭvā makarākṣo niśācaraḥ krodhān alasam āviṣṭo vacanaṃ cedam abravīt
english: Seeing the rākṣasas checked, Makarākṣa the night-rover, seized with a smouldering rage, spoke these words:

sanskrit: tiṣṭha rāma mayā sārdhaṃ dvandvayuddhaṃ dadāmi te tyājayiṣyāmi te prāṇān dhanurmuktaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
english: "Stand, Rāma! I offer you single combat. I shall make you abandon your life with sharp arrows loosed from my bow."

sanskrit: yat tadā daṇḍakāraṇye pitaraṃ hatavān mama madagrataḥ svakarmasthaṃ smṛtvā roṣo 'bhivardhate
english: "When you slew my father in the Daṇḍaka forest before my very eyes, as he was engaged in his own deeds—remembering that, my rage increases."

sanskrit: dahyante bhṛśam aṅgāni durātman mama rāghava yan mayāsi na dṛṣṭas tvaṃ tasmin kāle mahāvane
english: "My limbs burn fiercely, O wicked Rāghava, because I could not find you at that time in the great forest."

sanskrit: diṣṭyāsi darśanaṃ rāma mama tvaṃ prāptavān iha kāṅkṣito 'si kṣudhārtasya siṃhasyevetaro mṛgaḥ
english: "By good fortune you have come within my sight here, Rāma. You are as longed for as another animal is longed for by a hungry lion."

sanskrit: adya madbāṇavegena pretarāḍ viṣayaṃ gataḥ ye tvayā nihatāḥ śūrāḥ saha tais tvaṃ sameṣyasi
english: "Today, through the speed of my arrows, you will go to the realm of the king of the dead. You shall meet again with the heroes you yourself have slain."

sanskrit: bahunātra kim uktena śṛṇu rāma vaco mama paśyantu sakalā lokās tvāṃ māṃ caiva raṇājire
english: "Why say more? Hear my words, Rāma. Let all the worlds witness you and me upon the battlefield."

sanskrit: astrair vā gadayā vāpi bāhubhyāṃ vā mahāhave abhyastaṃ yena vā rāma tena vā vartatāṃ yudhi
english: "Whether with missiles, or with a mace, or with your bare arms in this great battle—let it be fought, Rāma, with whatever you have practised."

sanskrit: makarākṣavacaḥ śrutvā rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ abravīt prahasan vākyam uttarottaravādinam
english: Hearing Makarākṣa's words, Rāma the son of Daśaratha replied with a smile to that boastful speaker:

sanskrit: caturdaśasahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ tvatpitā ca yaḥ triśirā dūṣaṇaś cāpi daṇḍake nihatā mayā
english: "Fourteen thousand rākṣasas, and your father himself, and Triśirā and Dūṣaṇa as well—all were slain by me in the Daṇḍaka."

sanskrit: svāśitās tava māṃsena gṛdhragomāyuvāyasāḥ bhaviṣyanty adya vai pāpa tīkṣṇatuṇḍanakhāṅkuśāḥ
english: "Vultures, jackals, and crows with sharp beaks and hooked talons shall today be well-fed on your flesh, O wicked one."

sanskrit: evam uktas tu rāmeṇa kharaputro niśācaraḥ bāṇaughān asṛjat tasmai rāghavāya raṇājire
english: Thus addressed by Rāma, the son of Khara, the night-rover, released showers of arrows against Rāghava on the battlefield.

sanskrit: tāñ śarāñ śaravarṣeṇa rāmaś ciccheda naikadhā nipetur bhuvi te chinnā rukmapuṅkhāḥ sahasraśaḥ
english: Rāma cut down those arrows with his own rain of arrows in manifold ways; those severed shafts with golden feathers fell to the earth by the thousands.

sanskrit: tad yuddham abhavat tatra sametyānyonyam ojasā khara rākṣasaputrasya sūnor daśarathasya ca
english: There ensued that battle, each pressing the other with full force, between the son of the rākṣasa Khara and the son of Daśaratha.

sanskrit: jīmūtayor ivākāśe śabdo jyātalayos tadā dhanur muktaḥ svanotkṛṣṭaḥ śrūyate ca raṇājire
english: Like the sound of two storm-clouds in the sky, the resounding clap of their bowstrings and the ringing of arrows loosed from the bow were heard on the battlefield.

sanskrit: devadānavagandharvāḥ kiṃnarāś ca mahoragāḥ antarikṣagatāḥ sarve draṣṭukāmās tad adbhutam
english: Gods, dānavas, gandharvas, kiṃnaras, and great serpents—all gathered in the sky, eager to witness that marvel.

sanskrit: viddham anyonyagātreṣu dviguṇaṃ vardhate balam kṛtapratikṛtānyonyaṃ kurvāte tau raṇājire
english: Wounded in each other's limbs, their strength grew twofold; each answering the other's blow with a blow, those two fought on the battlefield.

sanskrit: rāmam uktās tu bāṇaughān rākṣasas tv acchinad raṇe rakṣomuktāṃs tu rāmo vai naikadhā prācchinac charaiḥ
english: The arrows loosed at Rāma were cut down by the rākṣasa in battle; and the arrows loosed by the rākṣasa were cut down by Rāma in many ways with his shafts.

sanskrit: bāṇaughavitatāḥ sarvā diśaś ca vidiśas tathā saṃchannā vasudhā caiva samantān na prakāśate
english: All the cardinal and intermediate directions were filled with showers of arrows; the earth too was covered on all sides and could not be seen.

sanskrit: tataḥ kruddho mahābāhur dhanuś ciccheda rakṣasaḥ aṣṭābhir atha nārācaiḥ sūtaṃ vivyādha rāghavaḥ bhittvā śarai rathaṃ rāmo rathāśvān samapātayat
english: Then mighty-armed Rāghava in his fury cut the rākṣasa's bow, pierced the charioteer with eight iron arrows, shattered the chariot with his shafts, and brought down the chariot-horses.

sanskrit: viratho vasudhāṃ tiṣṭhan makarākṣo niśācaraḥ atiṣṭhad vasudhāṃ rakṣaḥ śūlaṃ jagrāha pāṇinā trāsanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yugāntāgnisamaprabham
english: Dismounted and standing on the ground, Makarākṣa the night-rover took in his hand a spear that was the terror of all living beings, blazing like the fire at the end of an age.

sanskrit: vibhrāmya ca mahac chūlaṃ prajvalantaṃ niśācaraḥ sa krodhāt prāhiṇot tasmai rāghavāya mahāhave
english: Whirling that great blazing spear, the night-rover hurled it in fury at Rāghava in the great battle.

sanskrit: tam āpatantaṃ jvalitaṃ kharaputrakarāc cyutam bāṇais tu tribhir ākāśe śūlaṃ ciccheda rāghavaḥ
english: That blazing spear flying toward him, loosed from the hand of Khara's son, was cut apart in the air by Rāghava with three arrows.

sanskrit: sacchinno naikadhā śūlo divyahāṭakamaṇḍitaḥ vyaśīryata mahokleva rāmabāṇārdito bhuvi
english: That spear, adorned with divine gold, cut asunder in many pieces, tormented by Rāma's arrows, scattered and fell to the earth like a great meteor.

sanskrit: tac chūlaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇādbhutakarmaṇā sādhu sādhv iti bhūtāni vyāharanti nabhogatāḥ
english: Seeing that spear destroyed by Rāma of marvellous deeds, the beings moving in the sky exclaimed: "Well done! Well done!"

sanskrit: tad dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ śūlaṃ makarākṣo niśācaraḥ muṣṭim udyamya kākutsthaṃ tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt
english: Seeing his spear destroyed, Makarākṣa the night-rover raised his fist and cried out to Kākutstha: "Stand! Stand!"

sanskrit: sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā patantaṃ vai prahasya raghunandanaḥ pāvakāstraṃ tato rāmaḥ saṃdadhe svaśarāsane
english: Seeing him rushing forward, the delight of the Raghu line, Rāma, laughed and then fitted the Fire-missile to his own bow.

sanskrit: tenāstreṇa hataṃ rakṣaḥ kākutsthena tadā raṇe saṃchinnahṛdayaṃ tatra papāta ca mamāra ca
english: The rākṣasa, struck by that missile by Kākutstha in battle, his heart cleft asunder, fell there and died.

sanskrit: dṛṣṭvā te rākṣasāḥ sarve makarākṣasya pātanam laṅkām eva pradhāvanta rāmabālārditās tadā
english: Seeing the fall of Makarākṣa, all those rākṣasas, afflicted by the might of Rāma's arrows, fled back to Laṅkā.

sanskrit: daśarathanṛpaputrabāṇavegai rajanicaraṃ nihataṃ kharātmajaṃ tam dadṛśur atha ca devatāḥ prahṛṣṭā girim iva vajrahataṃ yathā viśīrṇam
english: The gods too beheld with great joy that night-rover, the son of Khara, slain by the speed of the arrows of the son of King Daśaratha—fallen like a mountain shattered by the thunderbolt.
